title: A hot CPU sensor holds no launch: pressure alone waits, and the sensor halves the trial cap
description: GY-3501: the loop reads the hottest CPU sensor the trial guard reads, and a hot reading holds no launch — at 99C, with PSI avg60 at 20, a ready item launches in the first cycle and its submitted head is trialled with the merge writer's cap halved from 4 to 2; no launches-waiting line stands, and a session already running is untouched. Below the halving limit (79C) the full cap returns. Only PSI pressure above the ceiling holds launches. Where no CPU sensor is readable the check is skipped. Master status carries the hottest sensor, and the Workers page shows it beside CPU pressure at 1280 px and 390 px.
